Piecewise uniform accrual

Source: R/ms_accrual.R
ms_accrual.Rd

Defines the accrual pattern either by accrual rates or by the proportions of patients enrolled in intervals of a given accrual duration.

Usage

ms_accrual(time = 0, rate = NULL, prop = NULL, duration = NULL)

Arguments

time

Interval start times (calendar time from the start of the study). Must start at 0 and be strictly increasing.

rate

Accrual rates in each interval (patients per unit time).

prop

Proportions of patients enrolled in each interval (summing to 1).

duration

Accrual duration (with prop).

Value

An object of class ms_accrual.

Details

With rate, patients are enrolled at rate[j] patients per unit time from time[j] on, and the accrual duration follows from the sample size. The last rate applies until the sample size is reached.

With prop and duration, a proportion prop[j] of the patients is enrolled uniformly in the interval starting at time[j], and the last interval ends at duration. The accrual rates then scale with the sample size. When ms_size solves for the accrual duration, all interval limits are scaled by the same factor.

See also

ms_scenario

Examples

# 10 patients per month in the first 3 months, then 30 per month
ms_accrual(time = c(0, 3), rate = c(10, 30))
#> Piecewise uniform accrual by rates (patients per unit time):
#>  time rate
#>     0   10
#>     3   30

# 30 percent of the patients in the first 6 months of an 18-month accrual
ms_accrual(time = c(0, 6), prop = c(0.3, 0.7), duration = 18)
#> Piecewise uniform accrual by proportions, duration 18:
#>  time prop
#>     0  0.3
#>     6  0.7
